description: Check Git and optionally install pinned lazygit and delta under ~/.local/bin. Each tool can be installed separately from the Git plugin. Existing Git configuration is unchanged.

steps.description: Check that Git is installed. Install Git using your server’s package manager if this check fails; no sudo commands are run.
steps.run: printf "%s\n" "Install Git using your server package manager, then run setup again." >&2; exit 1

steps.description: Install lazygit 0.65.1 from a pinned official GitHub release into ~/.local/bin; verify SHA-256 before extraction. No root or shell/Git configuration changes.
Install delta 0.19.2 from a pinned official GitHub release into ~/.local/bin; verify SHA-256 before extraction. No root or shell/Git configuration changes.
